ordering_tiers.tier_1: Baseline — ordered for every new patient
ordering_tiers.tier_2: Expanded — ordered based on tier_1 results or hallmark activation
ordering_tiers.tier_3: Specialty — ordered based on tier_2 results or specific clinical indication

_metadata.source_notes: Panel definitions based on standard clinical laboratory practice with longevity-medicine overlays. Codes are representative; verify with Quest/LabCorp at time of ordering.

panels.description: 14-marker panel covering kidney function, liver function, electrolytes, glucose, and protein levels
panels.clinical_indication: Annual screening, metabolic monitoring
panels.longevity_relevance: Baseline metabolic health assessment; albumin and ALP are PhenoAge components

panels.description: 18-marker complete blood count with differential; assesses red cells, white cells, platelets, and immune cell subsets
panels.clinical_indication: Annual screening, anemia workup, immune assessment
panels.longevity_relevance: WBC, RDW, MCV, and lymphocyte % are PhenoAge components; immunosenescence tracking

panels.description: 5-marker fasting lipid panel covering total cholesterol, LDL, HDL, triglycerides, and VLDL
panels.clinical_indication: Annual cardiovascular risk screening
panels.longevity_relevance: Cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of mortality; lipid optimization is foundational

panels.description: 5-marker fasting panel assessing insulin resistance, glycemic control, and metabolic health
panels.clinical_indication: Metabolic syndrome screening, insulin resistance assessment, diabetes prevention
panels.longevity_relevance: Insulin resistance is a primary driver of accelerated aging via mTOR/AMPK dysregulation

panels.description: TSH screening for thyroid dysfunction; the single best initial thyroid test
panels.clinical_indication: Annual thyroid screening, fatigue workup
panels.longevity_relevance: Thyroid function governs metabolic rate, mitochondrial biogenesis, and cardiovascular health

panels.description: 2-marker panel assessing systemic inflammation via hsCRP and ESR
panels.clinical_indication: Cardiovascular risk stratification, chronic inflammation screening
panels.longevity_relevance: Inflammaging (chronic low-grade inflammation) is a hallmark driver of all aging-related diseases

panels.description: 25-OH Vitamin D measurement; the primary circulating form reflecting vitamin D status
panels.clinical_indication: Annual vitamin D screening, bone health, immune function
panels.longevity_relevance: Vitamin D deficiency is associated with accelerated aging, immune dysfunction, and increased all-cause mortality

panels.description: 4-marker panel assessing iron stores, transport capacity, and saturation
panels.clinical_indication: Anemia workup, iron deficiency or overload assessment
panels.longevity_relevance: Iron dysregulation impairs mitochondrial function and promotes oxidative stress; ferritin is an acute-phase reactant

panels.description: 7-marker liver-specific panel covering transaminases, GGT, bilirubin, albumin, and total protein
panels.clinical_indication: Liver disease screening, medication monitoring, NAFLD assessment
panels.longevity_relevance: Liver health is central to metabolic detoxification, protein synthesis, and longevity

panels.description: 3-marker kidney function panel with creatinine, BUN, and CKD-EPI eGFR
panels.clinical_indication: Annual kidney function screening, CKD monitoring
panels.longevity_relevance: Kidney function declines with age; eGFR is a strong predictor of cardiovascular and all-cause mortality

panels.description: 8-marker advanced lipid panel including ApoB, ApoA1, Lp(a), NMR particle counts and sizes, sdLDL, and lipoprotein fractionation
panels.clinical_indication: Elevated LDL, family history of premature CVD, statin therapy monitoring
panels.longevity_relevance: ApoB and Lp(a) are superior CVD risk predictors; NMR particle size reveals atherogenic phenotype

panels.description: 5-marker panel assessing vascular inflammation including Lp-PLA2, fibrinogen, homocysteine, MPO, and oxidized LDL
panels.clinical_indication: Elevated hsCRP, cardiovascular risk stratification, atherosclerosis assessment
panels.longevity_relevance: Vascular inflammation drives atherosclerosis; MPO and oxidized LDL indicate active plaque vulnerability

panels.description: 4-marker panel assessing cardiac stress, injury, and thrombotic risk via NT-proBNP, troponins, and D-dimer
panels.clinical_indication: Heart failure screening, cardiac injury assessment, thrombotic risk
panels.longevity_relevance: NT-proBNP is a sensitive marker of subclinical cardiac dysfunction; elevated troponin indicates myocardial stress

panels.description: 9-marker comprehensive thyroid panel including TSH, free and total T3/T4, reverse T3, TPO antibodies, thyroglobulin antibodies, and TBG
panels.clinical_indication: Abnormal TSH, hypothyroid symptoms, autoimmune thyroid disease workup
panels.longevity_relevance: Optimal thyroid function is essential for mitochondrial biogenesis, metabolic rate, and cognitive health

panels.description: 8-marker male hormone panel covering testosterone (total and free), SHBG, estradiol, LH, FSH, prolactin, and DHEA-S
panels.clinical_indication: Low libido, fatigue, muscle loss, erectile dysfunction, andropause assessment
panels.longevity_relevance: Testosterone and DHEA-S decline with age; optimization associated with improved body composition, cognition, and longevity

panels.description: 10-marker female hormone panel covering testosterone, SHBG, estradiol, progesterone, LH, FSH, prolactin, DHEA-S, and AMH
panels.clinical_indication: Menstrual irregularities, perimenopause/menopause assessment, fertility evaluation, PCOS workup
panels.longevity_relevance: Estrogen and progesterone decline drives cardiovascular risk, bone loss, and cognitive decline in women

panels.description: 3-marker adrenal panel assessing cortisol (AM and PM) and DHEA-S
panels.clinical_indication: Fatigue, stress response assessment, HPA axis evaluation
panels.longevity_relevance: Cortisol dysregulation accelerates aging; DHEA-S is a longevity biomarker that declines with age

panels.description: 3-marker panel assessing the growth hormone/IGF-1 axis including IGF-1, IGFBP-3, and growth hormone
panels.clinical_indication: Growth hormone deficiency, somatotropic axis assessment, longevity optimization
panels.longevity_relevance: IGF-1 is a key mTOR activator; optimal (not excessive) IGF-1 is associated with longevity

panels.description: 6-marker panel assessing cytokines and inflammatory mediators including IL-6, TNF-alpha, complement, calprotectin, and fibrinogen
panels.clinical_indication: Elevated hsCRP, autoimmune disease workup, SASP assessment
panels.longevity_relevance: IL-6 and TNF-alpha are primary SASP cytokines driving cellular senescence and inflammaging

panels.description: 5-marker immune panel assessing NK cells, CD4/CD8 T cells, and lymphocyte subsets
panels.clinical_indication: Immunosenescence assessment, recurrent infections, immune optimization
panels.longevity_relevance: CD4:CD8 ratio inversion and NK cell decline are hallmarks of immunosenescence

panels.description: 8-marker panel assessing key micronutrients including B12, folate, B6, magnesium (RBC), zinc, selenium, and CoQ10
panels.clinical_indication: Fatigue, cognitive decline, methylation support, mitochondrial optimization
panels.longevity_relevance: Micronutrient deficiencies accelerate aging; CoQ10 and magnesium are critical for mitochondrial function

panels.description: 5-marker fasting panel assessing omega-3 index, omega-6:omega-3 ratio, EPA, DHA, and sdLDL
panels.clinical_indication: Cardiovascular risk, inflammation, omega-3 supplementation monitoring
panels.longevity_relevance: Omega-3 index >8% is associated with reduced cardiovascular mortality and slower biological aging

panels.description: 5-marker extended kidney panel including cystatin C, eGFR (cystatin), urine albumin:creatinine ratio, urine protein:creatinine ratio, and PTH
panels.clinical_indication: Elevated creatinine, CKD staging, proteinuria assessment
panels.longevity_relevance: Cystatin C is a more sensitive GFR marker; microalbuminuria is an early marker of vascular damage

panels.description: 4-marker coagulation panel assessing clotting time (PT, INR, PTT) and fibrin degradation (D-dimer)
panels.clinical_indication: Thrombotic risk, anticoagulation monitoring, bleeding disorder workup
panels.longevity_relevance: Hypercoagulability is associated with cardiovascular events and accelerated vascular aging

panels.description: 4-marker autoimmune screening panel including ANA, anti-dsDNA, IgG, and IgA
panels.clinical_indication: Autoimmune disease screening, elevated inflammatory markers, joint pain
panels.longevity_relevance: Autoimmune activation accelerates inflammaging and tissue damage

panels.description: 3-marker male cancer screening panel including PSA, CEA, and AFP
panels.clinical_indication: Annual cancer screening in males >40, prostate cancer monitoring
panels.longevity_relevance: Early cancer detection is critical for longevity; PSA screening reduces prostate cancer mortality

panels.description: 4-marker female cancer screening panel including CA-125, CA 15-3, CEA, and AFP
panels.clinical_indication: Annual cancer screening in females, ovarian and breast cancer monitoring
panels.longevity_relevance: Early detection of gynecologic cancers significantly improves survival outcomes

panels.description: 3-marker gastrointestinal cancer screening panel including CEA, CA 19-9, and AFP
panels.clinical_indication: GI cancer screening, colorectal and pancreatic cancer monitoring
panels.longevity_relevance: Colorectal cancer is highly preventable with early detection; CEA tracks treatment response

panels.description: 4-marker panel assessing fat-soluble vitamins A, E, K2, and D
panels.clinical_indication: Malabsorption, fat-soluble vitamin deficiency, antioxidant status
panels.longevity_relevance: Vitamins A, E, K2, and D have synergistic roles in immune function, bone health, and cardiovascular protection

panels.description: 6-marker panel assessing B12, folate, B6, B2, B1, and niacin (B3)
panels.clinical_indication: Elevated homocysteine, cognitive decline, neuropathy, methylation support
panels.longevity_relevance: B vitamins are essential methyl donors for epigenetic regulation; NAD+ precursors (B3) support mitochondrial function

panels.description: 6-marker stool panel assessing gut inflammation, pancreatic function, H. pylori, SIBO, and pathogen screening
panels.clinical_indication: GI symptoms, IBS, IBD workup, microbiome optimization
panels.longevity_relevance: Gut dysbiosis drives systemic inflammation and is linked to accelerated biological aging

panels.description: 8-marker advanced stool panel assessing intestinal permeability, secretory IgA, short-chain fatty acids, and microbiome diversity
panels.clinical_indication: Leaky gut, microbiome diversity assessment, SCFA production, estrogen metabolism
panels.longevity_relevance: Butyrate production and microbiome diversity are key longevity markers; zonulin reflects gut barrier integrity

panels.description: 4-marker panel assessing the most common toxic metal exposures: lead, mercury, arsenic, and cadmium
panels.clinical_indication: Occupational exposure, seafood consumption, environmental toxin assessment
panels.longevity_relevance: Heavy metal accumulation causes mitochondrial dysfunction, DNA damage, and accelerated aging

panels.description: 6-marker extended toxic metals panel adding aluminum and nickel to the basic panel
panels.clinical_indication: Elevated basic metals, neurological symptoms, kidney dysfunction from metal exposure
panels.longevity_relevance: Aluminum and nickel contribute to neurodegeneration and oxidative stress

panels.description: 5-marker urine panel assessing mold-derived toxins including aflatoxin B1, ochratoxin A, trichothecene T-2, zearalenone, and gliotoxin
panels.clinical_indication: Mold exposure, chronic fatigue, unexplained neurological symptoms
panels.longevity_relevance: Mycotoxins cause DNA damage, mitochondrial dysfunction, and immune suppression

panels.description: 8-marker urine panel assessing endocrine-disrupting chemicals including BPA, phthalates, PFAS compounds, and glyphosate
panels.clinical_indication: Endocrine disruption, hormone imbalance, environmental exposure assessment
panels.longevity_relevance: PFAS and phthalates disrupt hormonal signaling and are associated with accelerated epigenetic aging

panels.description: 4-marker DNA methylation panel measuring biological age via GrimAge, DunedinPACE, Horvath clock, and PhenoAge
panels.clinical_indication: Biological age assessment, longevity optimization, intervention monitoring
panels.longevity_relevance: Epigenetic clocks are the most accurate measures of biological age and mortality risk

panels.description: 2-marker panel measuring telomere length in leukocytes and p16-INK4a expression as a senescence marker
panels.clinical_indication: Cellular senescence burden assessment, telomere biology, senolytics monitoring
panels.longevity_relevance: Telomere shortening and p16 elevation are direct measures of cellular senescence burden

panels.description: 4-marker pharmacogenomics panel assessing CYP2D6, CYP2C19, CYP3A4 phenotypes and a comprehensive PGx flag
panels.clinical_indication: Medication selection, polypharmacy optimization, adverse drug reaction prevention
panels.longevity_relevance: PGx-guided prescribing prevents adverse drug reactions and optimizes therapeutic efficacy

panels.description: 5-marker genetic panel assessing APOE genotype, MTHFR variants (C677T and A1298C), PCSK9 variant, and FTO obesity risk
panels.clinical_indication: Alzheimer's risk stratification, methylation optimization, cardiovascular genetic risk
panels.longevity_relevance: APOE4 is the strongest genetic risk factor for Alzheimer's; MTHFR variants affect methylation and homocysteine

panels.description: 3-marker urine organic acids panel assessing metabolic byproducts, methylmalonic acid (B12 functional status), and oxalate
panels.clinical_indication: Mitochondrial dysfunction, Krebs cycle assessment, functional B12 deficiency, yeast overgrowth
panels.longevity_relevance: Organic acids reveal mitochondrial metabolic bottlenecks not visible on standard labs

panels.description: 2-marker plasma amino acid panel assessing comprehensive amino acid profile and taurine
panels.clinical_indication: Protein metabolism assessment, amino acid deficiency, mTOR signaling optimization
panels.longevity_relevance: Amino acid balance affects mTOR signaling; taurine deficiency is associated with accelerated aging

panels.description: 6-marker dried urine hormone panel assessing cortisol metabolites, estrogen metabolites, progesterone, androgens, melatonin, and OAT markers
panels.clinical_indication: Comprehensive hormone metabolism assessment, HRT monitoring, adrenal fatigue, estrogen dominance
panels.longevity_relevance: DUTCH provides hormone metabolite patterns not visible in serum; estrogen metabolism affects cancer risk

panels.description: 4-marker saliva and urine panel assessing 4-point cortisol rhythm, DHEA, adrenal stress index, and melatonin
panels.clinical_indication: HPA axis dysfunction, sleep disorders, chronic stress, adrenal fatigue
panels.longevity_relevance: Cortisol rhythm disruption accelerates aging; melatonin decline is a hallmark of aging

panels.description: 8-marker urine panel assessing serotonin, dopamine, norepinephrine, epinephrine, and their metabolites (5-HIAA, HVA, VMA) plus a comprehensive neurotransmitter metabolite flag
panels.clinical_indication: Depression, anxiety, cognitive decline, sleep disorders, Parkinson's risk
panels.longevity_relevance: Neurotransmitter balance affects cognitive longevity; dopamine and serotonin decline with age
